visualCharacteristics: Testimonial panel with a decorative quote glyph, large quote text and name/role citation; ice panel by default, dark ink panel in the dark variant.
contentPattern: One paragraph per cell: the longest paragraph is the quote, remaining paragraphs in order are name then role.
usage: Use to highlight a customer testimonial with its author name and role.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on case-study pages with quote, name and role rows; add dark for an ink panel.
